## Faster full-resolution video

Video now uses 16 sampling steps and can reuse intermediate model predictions during the middle of generation. The app selects the requested number of frames before H.264 encoding, then packages that stream for playback. This removes a second lossy encode. All three native frame sizes remain available.

On a 12 GB RTX 3060, a two-second 704 × 1280 rooftop fashion portrait took 208.1 seconds with the previous release workflow and 130.5 seconds with the updated workflow. Each timing is a single worker run including engine startup and MP4 verification. Both runs used the same prompt, seed, model, frame count and dimensions. The figure applies to this test. Results vary by prompt, hardware and clip length.

The packaged app generated a separate four-second portrait in 256.9 seconds. Preview playback and export passed. We inspected frames across both shots, checked H.264 format and unique decoded frames, and ran the four composer and recovery checks.
